items.title: Malankara Orthodox Church responds to Patriarch of Antioch’s call for peace, stresses respect for court verdicts
points: Welcoming Patriarch of Antioch Ignatius Aphrem II’s call for lasting peace in the Malankara Church, the Malankara Orthodox Syrian Church on Wednesday said reconciliation could be achieved immediately if the laws of the country and the Church were respected.
In a statement, Yuhanon Mar Diascoros Metropolitan, president of the Church’s media wing, cautioned that a call for peace would ring hollow if accompanied by attempts to defy court verdicts.
He pointed out that the Patriarch required the permission of the Catholicos and Malankara Metropolitan to enter churches belonging to the Malankara Church, as made clear in the 1995 court verdict.
The 2017 Supreme Court verdict had also categorically ruled out parallel administration in the Church, he said.
The Metropolitan said the relationship between the Malankara Church and the Antiochian Church had been clearly defined by the Mulanthuruthy Synod of 1876.
The Synod had recognised the Patriarch as the spiritual head, a position also acknowledged by the Mavelikkara Synod of 1754.

items.title: Beyond US, UK: Where Indian students are heading, according to VFS Global CEO | HTLS 2026

The 15,516 TEU Maersk-operated vessel struck the crane at the Shenzhen terminal at around noon local time.

items.title: UPI MDR rollout after Diwali: What it means for Paytm, MobiKwik and Pine Labs | What investors should know
points: With the Diwali festive period drawing to a close, attention is turning to the implementation of Merchant Discount Rate (MDR) charges on select person-to-merchant (P2M) Unified Payments Interface (UPI) transactions.
The revised framework could mark a significant shift for India's digital payments industry, creating a recurring revenue stream for payment companies such as Paytm and Pine Labs.
The National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) had initially scheduled the revised MDR framework to take effect from 15 October.
In a statement issued on 13 October, NPCI said the charges would be implemented immediately after Diwali, with the revised effective date to be notified separately.
According to Emkay Global Financial Services, the framework is expected to affect only around 4% of overall merchant transaction volumes.

Using conservative assumptions of realised MDR take rates of 10 basis points for Paytm and 6 basis points for Pine Labs, Emkay estimates that the two companies could generate UPI MDR revenue of ₹1,120 crore and ₹155 crore, respectively, in FY28.

items.title: Inflation At 2-Year High In October, Breaches RBI's Upper Limit
points: Retail inflation rose sharply to 6.09 per cent in October on costlier food items, breaching the RBI's upper tolerance limit of 6 per cent for the first time since October 2024.
The consumer price index (CPI) based headline retail inflation was 5.54 per cent in September.
Food inflation spiked to 8.94 per cent in October 2026 from 7.74 per cent in the previous month, according to the data released by the Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation.
The top five items with high inflation were onion (116.22 per cent), garlic (60.74 per cent), silver jewellery (52.39 per cent), ginger (48.32 per cent) and lemon (47.30 per cent).
This is the first time in two years that retail inflation has breached the RBI's upper tolerance band of 6 per cent.
In October 2024, retail inflation was 6.25 per cent.
The October retail inflation is a key data point before the December 2-4 meeting of the RBI monetary policy committee.
